title: Remove admin special signup password messaging from frontend

requirements.summary: Remove UI copy and error translations implying admins need a special signup password; ensure admin signup has no extra password field/step.
acceptanceCriteria: No screen, banner, form helper text, or error toast displays messaging that admins require a special signup password.
The signup error translation logic no longer returns a message indicating an "admin signup password is incorrect" (or equivalent), since the backend should not enforce that condition anymore.
Admin signup UX does not request a separate admin signup password field/step.

file_operations.description: Remove the special-case translation for "incorrect signup password" that tells users an admin signup password is required; replace with a neutral, non-password-specific message (e.g., generic signup failure or admin authorization guidance) while keeping other sanitization behavior intact.

Audit and remove any user-facing helper text, inline errors, or conditional UI related to an admin-only special signup password; confirm the admin path uses the same fields/flow as other roles (no extra admin password field/step) and that any displayed errors rely on the updated translateSignupError behavior.
